#!/bin/sh
# No certificates or account database here: public CNs, modes and live tunnel IPs.
set -eu
TOLF_DIR="${TOLF_OC_DIRECTORY:-/etc/ocserv-moscow}"
TOLF_RUN="${TOLF_OC_DEVICE_RUNTIME:-/var/run/tolf-oc-devices}"
TOLF_LOCK="${TOLF_OC_DEVICE_LOCK:-/tmp/tolf-oc-devices.lock}"
TOLF_SOCKET="${TOLF_OC_SOCKET:-/var/run/occtl-moscow.socket}"
TOLF_MODES="$TOLF_DIR/device-modes"

valid_cn() {
    case "$1" in tolf-oc-*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    TOLF_HEX="${1#tolf-oc-}"
    case "$TOLF_HEX" in *[!0-9a-f]*) return 1 ;; esac
    [ "${#TOLF_HEX}" -eq 32 ]
}
valid_ip() {
    case "$1" in 10.21.0.*|10.22.0.*|10.23.0.*|10.24.0.*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    TOLF_OCTET="${1##*.}"
    case "$TOLF_OCTET" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$1" in "10.21.0.$TOLF_OCTET"|"10.22.0.$TOLF_OCTET"|"10.23.0.$TOLF_OCTET"|"10.24.0.$TOLF_OCTET") ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    [ "$TOLF_OCTET" -ge 2 ] && [ "$TOLF_OCTET" -le 254 ]
}
valid_mode() { case "$1" in auto|ru|lv|yt) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac; }

acquire() {
    mkdir -p "$TOLF_RUN" "$TOLF_MODES" "$TOLF_DIR/config-per-user"
    chmod 700 "$TOLF_RUN" "$TOLF_MODES"
    TOLF_ATTEMPT=0
    until mkdir "$TOLF_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do
        TOLF_ATTEMPT=$((TOLF_ATTEMPT + 1))
        [ "$TOLF_ATTEMPT" -le 10 ] || return 1
        sleep 1
    done
    chmod 700 "$TOLF_LOCK"
    trap 'rm -rf "$TOLF_LOCK"' EXIT
    trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
}
release() { rm -rf "$TOLF_LOCK"; trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM; }

render() {
    if nft list chain inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo 'delete chain inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices'
    fi
    for TOLF_MODE in auto ru lv yt deny; do
        if nft list set inet fw4 "tolf_oc_device_$TOLF_MODE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            printf 'delete set inet fw4 tolf_oc_device_%s\n' "$TOLF_MODE"
        fi
        printf 'add set inet fw4 tolf_oc_device_%s { type ipv4_addr; }\n' "$TOLF_MODE"
    done
    echo 'add chain inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices { type filter hook prerouting priority mangle + 5; policy accept; }'
    for TOLF_RECORD in "$TOLF_RUN"/tolf-oc-*; do
        [ -f "$TOLF_RECORD" ] || continue
        TOLF_BASENAME="${TOLF_RECORD##*/}"
        TOLF_CN="${TOLF_BASENAME%%.*}"
        valid_cn "$TOLF_CN" || return 1
        TOLF_IP="$(cat "$TOLF_RECORD")"
        valid_ip "$TOLF_IP" || return 1
        if [ -f "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_CN" ]; then
            TOLF_MODE="$(cat "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_CN")"
            valid_mode "$TOLF_MODE" || return 1
        else TOLF_MODE=deny; fi
        printf 'add element inet fw4 tolf_oc_device_%s { %s }\n' "$TOLF_MODE" "$TOLF_IP"
    done
    echo 'add rule inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices ip saddr @tolf_oc_device_deny counter drop'
    echo 'add rule inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices ip saddr @tolf_oc_device_ru meta mark set 0x100 counter'
    for TOLF_MODE in auto lv yt; do
        printf 'add rule inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices ip saddr @tolf_oc_device_%s meta mark set 0x200 counter\n' "$TOLF_MODE"
    done
    for TOLF_MODE in auto yt; do
        for TOLF_SET in ru4 ru_domains4; do
            printf 'add rule inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices ip saddr @tolf_oc_device_%s ip daddr @%s meta mark set 0x100 counter\n' "$TOLF_MODE" "$TOLF_SET"
        done
    done
    echo 'add rule inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices ip saddr @tolf_oc_device_yt ip daddr @yt_domains4 meta mark set 0x100 counter'
}
apply_rules() {
    render > "$TOLF_LOCK/rules.nft" || return 1
    nft -c -f "$TOLF_LOCK/rules.nft" || return 1
    nft -f "$TOLF_LOCK/rules.nft"
    /usr/libexec/tolf-oc-external-exit refresh
}
clear_connections() {
    if command -v conntrack >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        for TOLF_RECORD in "$TOLF_RUN/$1".*; do
            [ -f "$TOLF_RECORD" ] || continue
            TOLF_IP="$(cat "$TOLF_RECORD")"
            valid_ip "$TOLF_IP" || return 1
            conntrack -D -f ipv4 -s "$TOLF_IP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        done
    fi
}

case "${1:-}" in
    hook)
        TOLF_USER="${USERNAME:-}"
        case "$TOLF_USER" in tolf-oc-*) valid_cn "$TOLF_USER" || exit 1 ;; *) TOLF_USER=legacy ;; esac
        TOLF_ID="${ID:-}"
        case "$TOLF_ID" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1 ;; esac
        [ "${#TOLF_ID}" -le 20 ]
        TOLF_IP="${IP_REMOTE:-}"
        valid_ip "$TOLF_IP"
        acquire
        case "${REASON:-}" in
            connect)
                # Remove stale leases before an IP is reused, including by the pilot.
                for TOLF_RECORD in "$TOLF_RUN"/tolf-oc-* "$TOLF_RUN"/legacy.*; do
                    [ -f "$TOLF_RECORD" ] || continue
                    if [ "$(cat "$TOLF_RECORD")" = "$TOLF_IP" ]; then rm -f "$TOLF_RECORD"; fi
                done
                if [ "$TOLF_USER" != legacy ]; then
                    [ -f "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER" ] || exit 1
                    valid_mode "$(cat "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER")"
                    printf '%s\n' "$TOLF_IP" > "$TOLF_RUN/$TOLF_USER.$TOLF_ID"
                else
                    printf '%s\n' "$TOLF_IP" > "$TOLF_RUN/legacy.$TOLF_ID"
                fi
                if ! apply_rules; then
                    rm -f "$TOLF_RUN/$TOLF_USER.$TOLF_ID"
                    exit 1
                fi
                ;;
            disconnect)
                TOLF_RECORD="$TOLF_RUN/$TOLF_USER.$TOLF_ID"
                if [ -f "$TOLF_RECORD" ] && [ "$(cat "$TOLF_RECORD")" = "$TOLF_IP" ]; then rm -f "$TOLF_RECORD"; fi
                apply_rules
                ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
        esac
        ;;
    set)
        [ "$#" -eq 3 ]; valid_cn "$2"; valid_mode "$3"
        TOLF_USER="$2"; TOLF_NEW_MODE="$3"
        acquire
        TOLF_OLD_MODE=""
        if [ -f "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER" ]; then TOLF_OLD_MODE="$(cat "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER")"; valid_mode "$TOLF_OLD_MODE"; fi
        printf '%s\n' "$TOLF_NEW_MODE" > "$TOLF_LOCK/mode.new"
        chmod 600 "$TOLF_LOCK/mode.new"
        mv "$TOLF_LOCK/mode.new" "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER"
        if ! apply_rules; then
            if [ -n "$TOLF_OLD_MODE" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$TOLF_OLD_MODE" > "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER"; else rm -f "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER"; fi
            exit 1
        fi
        printf 'max-same-clients = 1\n' > "$TOLF_DIR/config-per-user/$TOLF_USER"
        if [ "$TOLF_OLD_MODE" != "$TOLF_NEW_MODE" ]; then clear_connections "$TOLF_USER"; fi
        printf '{"status":"ok","username":"%s","mode":"%s"}\n' "$TOLF_USER" "$TOLF_NEW_MODE"
        ;;
    remove)
        [ "$#" -eq 2 ]; valid_cn "$2"; TOLF_USER="$2"
        acquire
        rm -f "$TOLF_MODES/$TOLF_USER" "$TOLF_DIR/config-per-user/$TOLF_USER"
        # Live leases become denied before releasing the lock and disconnecting.
        apply_rules
        clear_connections "$TOLF_USER"
        release
        occtl -s "$TOLF_SOCKET" disconnect user "$TOLF_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        if [ -S /var/run/occtl-ny-moscow.socket ]; then occtl -s /var/run/occtl-ny-moscow.socket disconnect user "$TOLF_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
        TOLF_ONLINE="$(/usr/libexec/tolf-oc-users "$TOLF_USER")"
        if [ "$TOLF_ONLINE" = true ]; then
            echo '{"status":"error","error":"device_still_connected"}'; exit 1
        else :; fi
        printf '{"status":"ok","username":"%s","removed":true}\n' "$TOLF_USER"
        ;;
    session)
        [ "$#" -eq 2 ]; valid_cn "$2"
        exec /usr/libexec/tolf-oc-users --status "$2"
        ;;
    apply)
        [ "$#" -eq 1 ]; acquire; apply_rules
        ;;
    pilot-clear)
        [ "$#" -eq 1 ]; acquire
        for TOLF_RECORD in "$TOLF_RUN"/legacy.*; do
            [ -f "$TOLF_RECORD" ] || continue
            TOLF_IP="$(cat "$TOLF_RECORD")"; valid_ip "$TOLF_IP"
            case "$TOLF_IP" in 10.21.0.*) conntrack -D -f ipv4 -s "$TOLF_IP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
        done
        ;;
    health)
        [ "$#" -eq 1 ]
        TOLF_CA="$TOLF_DIR/uk-client-ca.pem"
        TOLF_EXPECTED="$(cat "$TOLF_DIR/uk-client-ca.sha256")"
        [ "${#TOLF_EXPECTED}" -eq 64 ]; case "$TOLF_EXPECTED" in *[!0-9a-f]*) exit 1 ;; esac
        TOLF_ACTUAL="$(openssl x509 -in "$TOLF_CA" -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/.*=//' | tr -d ':' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')"
        [ "$TOLF_ACTUAL" = "$TOLF_EXPECTED" ]
        grep -Fx 'connect-script = /usr/bin/tolf-oc-device-hook' "$TOLF_DIR/ocserv.conf" >/dev/null
        grep -Fx 'disconnect-script = /usr/bin/tolf-oc-device-hook' "$TOLF_DIR/ocserv.conf" >/dev/null
        grep -Fx "config-per-user = $TOLF_DIR/config-per-user/" "$TOLF_DIR/ocserv.conf" >/dev/null
        openssl verify -CAfile "$TOLF_CA" -CRLfile "$TOLF_DIR/uk-client-ca.crl.pem" -crl_check "$TOLF_CA" >/dev/null
        occtl -s "$TOLF_SOCKET" --json show users >/dev/null
        nft list chain inet fw4 tolf_oc_devices >/dev/null
        printf '{"status":"ok","version":1,"caSha256":"%s","deviceRouting":true,"issuance":false}\n' "$TOLF_EXPECTED"
        ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported device operation' >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time

DB = "/etc/tolf-traffic/anyconnect.db"
TABLE = "tolf_accounting"

USER_RE = re.compile(r"^tolf-oc-[0-9a-f]{32}$")
ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9]{1,20}$")
IP_RE = re.compile(r"^10\.(21|22|23|24)\.0\.([1-9][0-9]{0,2})$")

def nft(*args, check=True):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["nft", *args],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
    )
    if check and p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("nft failed: " + p.stderr.strip())
    return p

def ensure_table():
    if nft("list", "table", "inet", TABLE, check=False).returncode != 0:
        nft("add", "table", "inet", TABLE)

    if nft("list", "chain", "inet", TABLE, "forward",
           check=False).returncode != 0:
        nft(
            "add", "chain", "inet", TABLE, "forward",
            "{ type filter hook forward priority -5; policy accept; }"
        )

def init_db():
    os.umask(0o077)
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=10)
    con.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    con.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
    with con:
        con.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS completed_sessions (
                session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                username TEXT NOT NULL,
                vpn_ip TEXT NOT NULL,
                connected_at INTEGER,
                disconnected_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                upload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                download_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                total_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        con.execute("""
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS completed_user_time
            ON completed_sessions(username, disconnected_at)
        """)
    return con

def env():
    reason = os.environ.get("REASON", "")
    username = os.environ.get("USERNAME", "")
    sid = os.environ.get("ID", "")
    ip = os.environ.get("IP_REMOTE", "")

    if reason not in ("connect", "disconnect"):
        raise ValueError("invalid reason")
    if not USER_RE.fullmatch(username):
        raise ValueError("invalid username")
    if not ID_RE.fullmatch(sid):
        raise ValueError("invalid session ID")

    m = IP_RE.fullmatch(ip)
    if not m or not 2 <= int(m.group(2)) <= 254:
        raise ValueError("invalid VPN IP")

    return reason, username, sid, ip

def counter_names(sid):
    return "oc_up_" + sid, "oc_down_" + sid

def delete_counter(name):
    nft("delete", "counter", "inet", TABLE, name, check=False)

def connect(username, sid, ip):
    ensure_table()
    up, down = counter_names(sid)

    delete_counter(up)
    delete_counter(down)

    nft("add", "counter", "inet", TABLE, up)
    nft("add", "counter", "inet", TABLE, down)

    nft(
        "add", "rule", "inet", TABLE, "forward",
        "ip", "saddr", ip,
        "counter", "name", up,
        "comment", f"TOLF-OC-UP-{sid}"
    )
    nft(
        "add", "rule", "inet", TABLE, "forward",
        "ip", "daddr", ip,
        "counter", "name", down,
        "comment", f"TOLF-OC-DOWN-{sid}"
    )

    now = int(time.time())
    con = init_db()
    with con:
        con.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS active_sessions (
                session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                username TEXT NOT NULL,
                vpn_ip TEXT NOT NULL,
                connected_at INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        con.execute("""
            INSERT INTO active_sessions
                (session_id,username,vpn_ip,connected_at)
            VALUES (?,?,?,?)
            ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
                username=excluded.username,
                vpn_ip=excluded.vpn_ip,
                connected_at=excluded.connected_at
        """, (sid, username, ip, now))
    con.close()

def read_counter(name):
    p = nft(
        "-j", "list", "counter", "inet", TABLE, name,
        check=False
    )
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return None

    data = json.loads(p.stdout)

    for item in data.get("nftables", []):
        c = item.get("counter")
        if c and c.get("name") == name:
            return int(c.get("bytes", 0))

    return None

def delete_session_rules(sid):
    p = nft("-a", "list", "chain", "inet", TABLE, "forward",
            check=False)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return

    handles = []
    needle1 = f'TOLF-OC-UP-{sid}'
    needle2 = f'TOLF-OC-DOWN-{sid}'

    for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
        if needle1 in line or needle2 in line:
            m = re.search(r"# handle ([0-9]+)", line)
            if m:
                handles.append(m.group(1))

    for handle in handles:
        nft(
            "delete", "rule", "inet", TABLE, "forward",
            "handle", handle,
            check=False
        )

def disconnect(username, sid, ip):
    ensure_table()
    up_name, down_name = counter_names(sid)

    upload = read_counter(up_name)
    download = read_counter(down_name)

    if upload is None or download is None:
        raise RuntimeError("session counters not found")

    now = int(time.time())

    con = init_db()

    row = con.execute("""
        SELECT connected_at
        FROM active_sessions
        WHERE session_id=? AND username=? AND vpn_ip=?
    """, (sid, username, ip)).fetchone()

    connected_at = row[0] if row else None

    with con:
        con.execute("""
            INSERT INTO completed_sessions
                (session_id,username,vpn_ip,
                 connected_at,disconnected_at,
                 upload_bytes,download_bytes,total_bytes)
            VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
            ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
                disconnected_at=excluded.disconnected_at,
                upload_bytes=excluded.upload_bytes,
                download_bytes=excluded.download_bytes,
                total_bytes=excluded.total_bytes
        """, (
            sid, username, ip,
            connected_at, now,
            upload, download, upload + download
        ))

    with con:
        con.execute(
            "DELETE FROM active_sessions WHERE session_id=?",
            (sid,)
        )

    con.close()

    delete_session_rules(sid)
    delete_counter(up_name)
    delete_counter(down_name)

def main():
    reason, username, sid, ip = env()

    if reason == "connect":
        connect(username, sid, ip)
    else:
        disconnect(username, sid, ip)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as e:
        print("tolf-oc-nft-accounting:", e, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time

SOCKET = "/var/run/occtl-moscow.socket"
DB = "/etc/tolf-traffic/anyconnect.db"

def get_users():
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/libexec/tolf-oc-users"],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        timeout=15,
    )
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("occtl failed: " + p.stderr.strip())
    data = json.loads(p.stdout)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise RuntimeError("unexpected occtl output")
    return data

def counter(dev, name):
    if not dev.startswith("vpns-mow"):
        raise ValueError("unexpected device")
    path = f"/sys/class/net/{dev}/statistics/{name}"
    with open(path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
        value = int(f.read().strip())
    if value < 0:
        raise ValueError("negative counter")
    return value

def main():
    os.umask(0o077)
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=10)
    con.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    con.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")

    with con:
        con.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
                session TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                username TEXT NOT NULL,
                device TEXT NOT NULL,
                vpn_ip TEXT,
                started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
                rx_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                tx_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        con.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS samples (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                session TEXT NOT NULL,
                username TEXT NOT NULL,
                device TEXT NOT NULL,
                rx_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                tx_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        con.execute("""
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS samples_user_time
            ON samples(username, observed_at)
        """)

    now = int(time.time())
    users = get_users()
    recorded = 0

    for u in users:
        username = u.get("Username")
        session = u.get("Full session") or u.get("Session")
        ocserv_id = u.get("ID")
        dev = u.get("Device")
        vpn_ip = u.get("IPv4")
        started = u.get("raw_session_started_at")

        if not (
            isinstance(username, str) and username.startswith("tolf-oc-") and
            isinstance(session, str) and session and
            isinstance(ocserv_id, int) and ocserv_id >= 0 and
            isinstance(dev, str) and dev.startswith("vpns-mow") and
            isinstance(started, int)
        ):
            continue

        try:
            rx = counter(dev, "rx_bytes")
            tx = counter(dev, "tx_bytes")
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue

        with con:
            con.execute("""
                INSERT INTO sessions
                    (session,username,device,vpn_ip,started_at,last_seen,
                     rx_bytes,tx_bytes)
                VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                ON CONFLICT(session) DO UPDATE SET
                    username=excluded.username,
                    device=excluded.device,
                    vpn_ip=excluded.vpn_ip,
                    last_seen=excluded.last_seen,
                    rx_bytes=excluded.rx_bytes,
                    tx_bytes=excluded.tx_bytes
            """, (session, username, dev, vpn_ip, started, now, rx, tx))

            con.execute("""
                INSERT INTO samples
                    (observed_at,session,username,device,
                     rx_bytes,tx_bytes,ocserv_id)
                VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
            """, (
                now, session, username, dev,
                rx, tx, str(ocserv_id)
            ))

        recorded += 1

    con.close()
    print(f"OK: recorded {recorded} active AnyConnect session(s)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR:", e, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time

DB="/etc/tolf-traffic/anyconnect.db"
SOCKET="/var/run/occtl-moscow.socket"

def live_ids():
    p=subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/libexec/tolf-oc-users"],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        timeout=15,
    )

    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("occtl unavailable")

    data=json.loads(p.stdout)

    return {
        str(u["ID"])
        for u in data
        if isinstance(u.get("ID"),int)
    }

def main():
    live=live_ids()
    now=int(time.time())

    con=sqlite3.connect(DB,timeout=10)
    con.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")

    active=list(con.execute("""
        SELECT session_id,username,vpn_ip,connected_at
        FROM active_sessions
    """))

    recovered=0

    for sid,user,ip,connected_at in active:
        if sid in live:
            continue

        row=con.execute("""
            SELECT observed_at,rx_bytes,tx_bytes
            FROM samples
            WHERE ocserv_id=?
            ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        """,(sid,)).fetchone()

        if row:
            observed,upload,download=row
            ended=observed
        else:
            upload=0
            download=0
            ended=now

        total=upload+download

        with con:
            con.execute("""
                INSERT INTO completed_sessions
                    (session_id,username,vpn_ip,
                     connected_at,disconnected_at,
                     upload_bytes,download_bytes,total_bytes,
                     completion_type)
                VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO NOTHING
            """,(
                sid,user,ip,
                connected_at,ended,
                upload,download,total,
                "recovered"
            ))

            con.execute(
                "DELETE FROM active_sessions WHERE session_id=?",
                (sid,)
            )

        recovered+=1

    con.close()

    print(
        f"OK: recovered {recovered} interrupted session(s)"
    )

if __name__=="__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as e:
        print("tolf-oc-recovery:",e,file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/bin/sh
# Public trust only. All signing and device state remain on UK.
set -eu
TOLF_DIR="${TOLF_OC_DIRECTORY:-/etc/ocserv-moscow}"
TOLF_SOCKET="${TOLF_OC_SOCKET:-/var/run/occtl-moscow.socket}"
TOLF_CA="$TOLF_DIR/uk-client-ca.pem"
TOLF_CRL="$TOLF_DIR/uk-client-ca.crl.pem"
TOLF_LOCK="${TOLF_OC_LOCK_DIRECTORY:-/tmp/tolf-oc-crl-sync.lock}"
TOLF_LAST_SYNC="${TOLF_OC_LAST_SYNC:-/tmp/tolf-oc-crl-last-sync}"

if ! mkdir "$TOLF_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "CRL synchronization is already running" >&2
    exit 1
fi
trap 'rm -rf "$TOLF_LOCK"' EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
chmod 700 "$TOLF_LOCK"

openssl x509 -in "$TOLF_CA" -outform DER -out "$TOLF_LOCK/ca.der"
TOLF_ACTUAL="$(sha256sum "$TOLF_LOCK/ca.der" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$TOLF_ACTUAL" = "$(cat "$TOLF_DIR/uk-client-ca.sha256")"

curl -fsS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 --max-filesize 1048576 \
    https://api.tolf.is/oc/access/crl.pem -o "$TOLF_LOCK/new.pem"
# This checks issuer, signature, CA validity and CRL last/next update times.
openssl verify -CAfile "$TOLF_CA" -CRLfile "$TOLF_LOCK/new.pem" \
    -crl_check "$TOLF_CA" >/dev/null

crl_number() {
    TOLF_NUMBER="$(openssl crl -in "$1" -noout -crlnumber)"
    TOLF_HEX="${TOLF_NUMBER#crlNumber=0x}"
    test "$TOLF_HEX" != "$TOLF_NUMBER" || return 1
    case "$TOLF_HEX" in ''|*[!0-9a-fA-F]*) return 1 ;; esac
    test "${#TOLF_HEX}" -le 8 || return 1
    printf '%s\n' "$((0x$TOLF_HEX))"
}

TOLF_NEW_NUMBER="$(crl_number "$TOLF_LOCK/new.pem")"
if [ -f "$TOLF_CRL" ]; then
    TOLF_OLD_NUMBER="$(crl_number "$TOLF_CRL")"
    if [ "$TOLF_NEW_NUMBER" -lt "$TOLF_OLD_NUMBER" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: CRL rollback rejected" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$TOLF_NEW_NUMBER" -eq "$TOLF_OLD_NUMBER" ]; then
        if ! cmp -s "$TOLF_CRL" "$TOLF_LOCK/new.pem"; then
            echo "ERROR: conflicting CRL with the same number" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        date +%s > "$TOLF_LAST_SYNC"
        exit 0
    fi
    cp -p "$TOLF_CRL" "$TOLF_LOCK/previous.pem"
fi

chmod 644 "$TOLF_LOCK/new.pem"
mv "$TOLF_LOCK/new.pem" "$TOLF_CRL"
reload_all() {
    occtl -s "$TOLF_SOCKET" reload || return 1
    if [ -S /var/run/occtl-ny-moscow.socket ]; then
        occtl -s /var/run/occtl-ny-moscow.socket reload || return 1
    fi
}
if ! reload_all; then
    if [ -f "$TOLF_LOCK/previous.pem" ]; then
        mv "$TOLF_LOCK/previous.pem" "$TOLF_CRL"
    else
        rm -f "$TOLF_CRL"
    fi
    reload_all >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    echo "ERROR: ocserv reload failed; previous CRL restored" >&2
    exit 1
fi
date +%s > "$TOLF_LAST_SYNC"
printf 'OK: signed CRL installed, number %s\n' "$TOLF_NEW_NUMBER"
/etc/init.d/ocserv-ny-moscow:
#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common
START=97
STOP=8
USE_PROCD=1
start_service() {
 ip route replace 10.250.81.1/32 dev greus proto 245 || return 1
 /usr/libexec/tolf-oc-devices apply || return 1
 procd_open_instance
 procd_set_param command /usr/sbin/ocserv -d 4 -s -f -c /etc/ocserv-ny-moscow/ocserv.conf
 procd_set_param respawn
 procd_set_param stdout 1
 procd_set_param stderr 1
 procd_close_instance
}
